turns.said: My printer queue is stuck and nothing prints.
turns.reply:
Hi Salma, I would be happy to help you with your printer queue. This issue usually happens when the local print spooler service gets stuck. You can try these steps to clear it:

1. Check that the printer is on and has paper and toner.
2. Open the 'Services' application on your computer, find 'Print Spooler', right-click it and choose 'Stop'.
3. Open File Explorer, go to C:\Windows\System32\spool\PRINTERS and delete all files in that folder.
4. Go back to 'Services', right-click 'Print Spooler' and choose 'Start'.
5. Try printing a test page.

Please let me know if this gets everything printing again!

   - Follow the prompts to add your email account, select "Always use this profile" to use the new one, and restart Outlook.
